name: biomapi-cli
description: Biometry data extraction from optical biometry reports via biomapi.com.

interface.shortDescription: Extract optical biometry reports and retrieve BiomPINs.
interface.longDescription: Process optical biometry PDFs, images, and JSON files through BiomAPI, retrieve shared BiomPIN data, generate CSV exports, and create ESCRS IOL Calculator links.
defaultPrompt: Process this biometry report with BiomAPI.
Generate a CSV from these BiomAPI results.
